contracts.persistence: Store is synchronous and idempotent; Postgres is async write-through; no nested savepoints.
contracts.governance: preflightAction runs blocking pre gates; deny is final; escalate is a warning in the generic pipeline.
contracts.audit: BehaviorOS.runAudit downgrades simulated reports to warning; raw AuditEngine is not downgraded.
contracts.plugin: 32 bos_* tools; storage snapshot sync with terminal merge.
contracts.mcp: 30 tools, stdio only; fresh process smoke test.

restrictions: No commit, push, tag, publish, deploy.
No changes to unrelated user files.
No simulated evidence counted as verification.
No bypass of a governance deny.
The running OpenCode host is stale; host-level runtime equivalence requires restart.
